riddle: In the Forbidden Forest, Ron Weasley is terrified of spiders and creepy crawlers. In computer programming, this tiny pest creeps into your source code and breaks your program until squashed.
hint: It rhymes with 'mug'. First famously found trapped in a Mark II computer relay in 1947.

riddle: Like Mystique or the Shape-shifter who can take on any identity, this fundamental programming container holds data whose value can change throughout the execution of a program.
hint: Declared with keywords like let, var, or const. Its value is not constant.

riddle: Sauron forged the One Ring into a continuous circle with no beginning and no end. In code, this construct repeats a block of instructions until a termination condition is met.
hint: Common types include 'for', 'while', and 'do-while'.

riddle: Jedi Master Yoda says 'Do or do not, there is no try.' In programming, this fundamental data type accepts only two possible values: true or false, 1 or 0.
hint: Named after mathematician George Boole. Often shortened to 'bool'.

riddle: Every time Harry chants 'Expecto Patronum', a reusable spell executes to ward off Dementors. In code, this named, reusable block of instructions takes inputs and returns an output whenever called.
hint: In Python you declare it with 'def', in JavaScript with 'function'. In OOP it's called a method.

riddle: Like the Infinity Gauntlet that holds six stones in designated slots, this indexed data structure stores an ordered collection of elements accessible starting at index 0.
hint: Surrounded by square brackets []. Elements are accessed by index numbers.

riddle: Like the Sacred Jedi Texts that preserved generations of history and wisdom, this distributed version control system lets developers record commits, make branches, and travel back through code history.
hint: Created by Linus Torvalds. Powers platforms like GitHub and GitLab.

riddle: Behind every simulation in the Matrix lies a foundational wireframe. On the World Wide Web, this markup language uses angle brackets and tags to create the backbone structure of every web page.
hint: Four letters: HyperText Markup Language.

riddle: The Transfiguration spell changes appearances, colors, and layouts. On the web, this stylesheet language styles HTML elements, adding beautiful colors, animations, and responsive layouts.
hint: Three letters. Cascading Style Sheets.

riddle: Morpheus bends reality by adding interactive rules to the Matrix. In web development, this scripting language gives life, click events, and dynamic behavior to static web pages in the browser.
hint: Often abbreviated as JS. Created in 10 days by Brendan Eich in 1995.

riddle: When Tony Stark tells J.A.R.V.I.S., 'SELECT suit FROM armory WHERE model = Mark_50', he's using a language very similar to this standard query language for relational databases.
hint: Three letters. Structured Query Language. You use SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE.

riddle: The Citadel library in Oldtown holds vast collections of scrolls organized by category across thousands of shelves. In tech, this system securely stores, organizes, and retrieves structured collections of data.
hint: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MongoDB are popular types of this (often abbreviated DB).

riddle: R2-D2 speaks in rapid bleeps and bloops that translate directly into machine code. What base-2 numeral system consisting of only 0s and 1s forms the foundational language of all digital hardware?
hint: Base 2. Two states: on/off, high/low voltage.

riddle: The Arc Reactor in Iron Man's chest powers his armor, but the brain that actually carries out calculations and instructions is this primary chip — often called the 'brain' of the computer.
hint: Three letters. Central Processing Unit. Intel and AMD manufacture them.

riddle: Like the Pensieve where memories are stored for quick temporary inspection while working, this volatile computer memory loses all its contents when the power is turned off.
hint: Three letters. Random Access Memory. Not your hard drive or SSD.

riddle: Eleven stacks Eggo waffles on her breakfast plate: she eats the topmost waffle first, while the first waffle made is eaten last (LIFO). What fundamental data structure follows this exact behavior?
hint: Last-In, First-Out (LIFO). Supported by push and pop operations.

riddle: Students queue up in single file at Platform 9 3/4 to board the Hogwarts Express: the first student in line is the first to step aboard (FIFO). What linear data structure is this?
hint: First-In, First-Out (FIFO). Used in printer tasks and task scheduling.

riddle: Doctor Strange trapped Dormammu in a time loop where the same scene invokes itself repeatedly until a bargaining condition is met. In programming, what is it called when a function calls itself?
hint: Requires a base case to avoid a Stack Overflow error.

riddle: In the Matrix, Tank operates the console and converts human battle commands into digital machine code. In programming, this software translates high-level code (like C++ or Java) into executable machine code.
hint: GCC, javac, and clang are examples. Different from an interpreter, it compiles beforehand.

riddle: Elrond lays out a precise, step-by-step quest for the Fellowship to travel from Rivendell to Mount Doom. In computer science, what do we call a defined, step-by-step set of instructions for solving a problem?
hint: Starts with 'A'. Binary Search, Dijkstra, and Bubble Sort are famous examples.

riddle: The massive Wall at Castle Black keeps dangerous wild threats outside the Seven Kingdoms. In computer networks, this security system monitors and blocks unauthorized traffic.
hint: A wall made of fire. Inspects packets and filters ports.

riddle: To enter the Batcave through Wayne Manor's grandfather clock, Bruce Wayne turns the clock hands to a secret combination. In security, this secret string of characters authenticates a user's identity.
hint: Often hashed with bcrypt or SHA. Never share it with anyone!

riddle: Lando Calrissian administers Cloud City, hovering high in the atmosphere. In modern tech, this term refers to storing files and running compute servers on remote data centers accessible over the internet.
hint: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google ______.

riddle: King's Landing receives ravens carrying requests from every lord across Westeros and sends back royal decrees and resources. In networking, what computer system listens for requests and serves responses to clients?
hint: Pairs with 'client' in the client-______ architecture.

riddle: Floo powder transports wizards to an exact hearth when they pronounce its address clearly. On the internet, this address string in your browser bar leads to an exact webpage or web resource.
hint: Three letters. Uniform Resource Locator. E.g., https://google.com

riddle: Every star system in the Galactic Empire has specific navigational coordinates (like Coruscant: 0, 0, 0). On the internet, this numerical label (like 192.168.1.1) uniquely identifies each connected device.
hint: Two letters + Address. IPv4 uses 32 bits, IPv6 uses 128 bits.

riddle: Ollivander holds the blueprint and formula for making wands before any individual wand is crafted. In Object-Oriented Programming, what template or blueprint defines the properties and methods for creating objects?
hint: Used with the 'new' keyword to instantiate objects. In Python: ______ Dog: ...

riddle: Bilbo's sword Sting glows blue around orcs. In programming, adding one letter transforms it into this essential text data type enclosed in quotation marks that holds a sequence of characters.
hint: Enclosed in single or double quotes. e.g. "Hello, World!"

riddle: Morpheus and Trinity don't click buttons with a mouse; they type fast commands into a dark text-based window. What command-line interface lets developers control the operating system using plain text?
hint: Also known as CLI, console, prompt, bash, or terminal window.

riddle: Madam Pomfrey uses healing spells to find injuries and restore sick wizards. In software development, what is the art of detecting, tracing, and removing errors from your code called?
hint: If finding problems is discovering bugs, this process removes them.
